replay_verification.principle: Any third party reads the tx from a public XRPL server and byte-compares the memo to the published root — no permission, no CSOAI tooling.
steps: 1. Take the tx hash from the submit response (engine_result tesSUCCESS, tx_json.hash)
4. Decode the memo (hex→ASCII) and assert it equals f1913ecaae4ea18ac113d341c1b050318cec4c49dcda440dacbbadb89eca1b4e
5. Independently fetch https://councilof.ai/root.json, sha256 the bytes, assert equality
6. Confirm validation: tx validated in ledger N (meta.TransactionResult == tesSUCCESS)
8. Record tx hash + ledger in interop/root-witness-latest.json witnesses.xrpl_memo (ATTESTED, replacing NOT_YET)

owner_action_needed: 1. Use a funded XRPL account (existing account avoids the reserve)
2. Sign this exact transaction (or identical memo) with the account secret — secret never enters this repo
3. Submit to XRPL mainnet; confirm tesSUCCESS
5. Record tx hash + ledger in the witness sidecar
